verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). It has no user interface of its own, so asking whether its API matches its UI is a category error for this kind of product. The developer SDKs and AI Hub model tooling in the pack concern model deployment, not parity between an API and a product UI, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
